name: Cyril Morlet
title: Senior Backend Engineer — Rust & EVM Systems · ex-Bitfinex
summary: Backend engineer with 12 years shipping production distributed systems. Rust in production: built and operate a chain indexer (~10.5K lines — axum, tokio, sui-indexer-alt-framework) streaming blockchain checkpoints into Redis-backed sub-second, performance-critical reads, and maintain a Rust gas-sponsorship service. Honest Rust depth: one production system, not a decade. Beside it: deep EVM client-side experience from Bitfinex — JSON-RPC clients, reorg handling, finality thresholds, fee accounting on deposit/withdrawal pipelines where bugs lose customer funds — plus state management between chain and clients, smart contracts (Solidity, Sui Move), and a decade of open source (110+ public repos). Reliability is the whole job when the money is real.
